LanguageData.Ratkin.label: Ratkin
LanguageData.Ratkin.description: Ratkins are genetically modified humans infused with rat genes. Although their origin is unknown, they seem to have a long history and maintain a monarchical society based primarily on agricultural production. They tend to be biologically androgynous and societally feminine, with the standard attire being dresses, even for male subjects.
